top_choice_rationale: P001 awards the optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye. It is a clue extracted from nature by measurement: magic-wavelength trapping is a clear concept, the 10^-18 performance has been reproduced independently at JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, PTB, SYRTE and NIST, and it has already delivered physics (millimetre-scale gravitational redshift, a many-body clock regime, limits on varying constants and ultralight dark matter). The two-name credit follows the two decisive steps, concept and record performance, and the citation scope is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. The discovery is mature and well defined, so no award is clearly inferior.
